/// About Origami

A studio for
culture-forward brands.

Origami is a web, mobile and real-money gaming studio based in California and India. Over the last decade we've built products across fintech, healthcare, gaming, ecommerce and hip-hop — and a staffing practice that helps teams scale without losing velocity.

/// Values

What we won't compromise on.

01

Craft over churn

We protect the work from urgency, opinion and theatre — then ship relentlessly.

02

Culture first

We don't just serve culture-forward brands. We hire from their audiences, and we build like fans.

03

Measured by impact

We track the metric that actually moves the business — not the number of tickets closed.

/// Timeline

How we got here.

2013
Founded by a small team in California.
2016

2019

2022
Launched IT staffing & dedicated team practice.
2024
Built HipHopGrails — an auction destination for hip-hop memorabilia.
2025
Expanded Class II & Class III gaming platform practice.
